local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

textLabel.Parent = screenGui
textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 100)

textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
textLabel.TextScaled = true

local function generateFakeIP()
    local ip = ""
    for i = 1, 3 do
        ip = ip .. math.random(0, 999)
        if i < 3 then
            ip = ip .. "."
        end
    end
    return ip
end

textLabel.Text = "Processing IP Logger..."
wait(0.3)
textLabel.Text = "Your IP is: " .. generateFakeIP()

local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

textLabel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = textLabel.Position
        input.Consumed = true
    end
end)

textLabel.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

textLabel.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

    end
end)
